logfacility.description: Syslog facility to use for heartbeat logs (e.g., 'local0', 'daemon', 'audit').

logfile.description: Path to the heartbeat log file. Set to 'off' to disable file logging.

keepalive.description: Seconds between heartbeat packets sent to peers.

deadtime.description: Seconds of missed heartbeats before a peer is declared dead.

warntime.description: Seconds before issuing a warning that a node is approaching deadtime.

initdead.description: Initial deadtime delay (in seconds) for first startup or after a crash.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to use for unicast heartbeat communication (e.g., ['eth0', 'bond0']).

items.description: Name of a network interface for heartbeat traffic.

nodes.description: List of node hostnames (must match /etc/hosts or DNS) participating in the cluster.

items.description: Fully qualified hostname or short hostname of a cluster node.

auto_failback.description: Whether to automatically return resources to the primary node once it recovers from failure.

authkey.description: Path to the authentication key file used to encrypt heartbeat messages.

respawn.description: Optional path to a respawnable daemon (e.g., ipfail for IP failover).
